facts.fact: On a genuine Rs 500 note the windowed security thread changes colour from green to blue when the note is tilted
facts.quote: Windowed security thread changes colour from green to blue when note is tilted

facts.fact: The numeral 500 with the Rupee symbol at bottom right is in colour-changing ink (green to blue)
facts.quote: Denomination in numerals with Rupee Symbol in colour changing ink (green to blue) on bottom right

facts.fact: It has Mahatma Gandhi portrait and electrotype (500) watermarks
facts.quote: Mahatma Gandhi's portrait and electrotype (500) watermarks

facts.fact: It has a see-through register of the numeral 500
facts.quote: See through register in denominational numeral

behaviour: Lists the security features of the Rs 500 note as published by RBI (Know your Banknotes / paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in), citing RBI.
fail_if: It gives features not on RBI's page, or cites no RBI source.
summary: RBI's Know your Banknotes page for the Rs 500 (Mahatma Gandhi New Series): colour-shifting thread and numeral, watermarks, see-through register.
